verdict.rationale: Airbyte offers PyAirbyte, an official Python SDK explicitly aimed at AI/ML developers, alongside a documented REST API (with auth via access tokens) and a Terraform provider for programmatic/config-as-code use, giving AI-native builders multiple first-party interfaces to build against. Missing for 10: SDKs beyond Python (e.g. JS/TS), independent/hands-on developer corroboration of the SDK's robustness, and a discoverable OpenAPI spec (probe found 404s).
